answer: Marble Registration Delay: each identity must publish a random salt and wait a fixed challenge window before acting, and any duplicate salt collapses both accounts. Honest agents pay only one window of latency; a sybil operator pays that same delay on every clone and must absorb the ocean of parallel timers without cross-account reuse. Since salts are checked by hash, an attacker cannot whisper one salt to many identities, making each clone carry full independent delay cost.
